# Arcadia Feeder Co.

> A kid-run reptile feeder business in Arcadia, California, serving reptile keepers across the San Gabriel Valley with locally bred Dubia roaches, superworms, and hornworms.

## About
- Founded 2026 by three middle-school students: Ed Shao (12), Ryan Shao (11), Maxyne Cho (12)
- Operates from Arcadia, CA
- Serves: Arcadia, Temple City, Pasadena, San Gabriel, Alhambra, Monrovia, San Marino, South Pasadena
- No shipping — local pickup or AUSD school drop-off only

## Products
- Dubia roaches (small/medium/large, cups of 25–100)
- Superworms (25/50/100 ct cups, bulk bags)
- Hornworms (12 or 25 ct, sized small/medium/large)
- Arcadia Calcium Care Kit (food-grade calcium carbonate for dusting)
- The Feeder Crate subscription (Starter $22, Standard $38, Family $68)
